tasks.title: The classic dialect's instrument mask is $7F where the player's own ASLs make it $1F
tasks.verify: The mask derived from `det.instr_stride` (x8 = three ASLs = 5 bits = & 0x1F; a 16-byte record shifts four times and masks & 0x0F), with a corpus byte-hash moving EXACTLY Mega_Apocalypse. MEASURED: `patterns.py:512` does `(b2 & 0x7F) + instr_base` while the player does `LDA $C9,X / ASL A / ASL A / ASL A / TAX` at $4BA2 -- an eight-bit shift that discards everything above bit 4, so byte $41 indexes record 1, not 65. 72 of 78 classic files carry the same `0A 0A 0A AA` shape but only Mega_Apocalypse has a pattern byte that sets bit $20 or $40. Anchor on the ASL-count actually present in each player rather than widening on one file.

tasks.title: Choose the route for the interleaved $83 arpeggio: instrument clones or CMD_SETWAVEPTR
tasks.verify: A costed choice between the two routes, then the emission, with the column movement on the six ilv files recorded. DURABLE ALREADY: $83's step counter is cleared at note start ($1397 inside the note-start block at $1388) so it is PER-NOTE state and a wavetable is the right container; the cycle is 0 / high nibble / low nibble, two-step when the low nibble is zero; 391 occurrences over six files; the operand varies per instrument (Lion_Heart instrument 5 carries four), so an instrument-level bake is refuted; and exactly ONE (file, instrument) pair is safe to bake. Route A: one clone per (record, operand) -- fits, 18-19 instruments against a limit of 50, largest file needs 9. Route B: CMD_SETWAVEPTR, Goattracker command 8, NOT defined in patterns.py -- cheaper on instruments but must register in BOTH TEMPO_OVERWRITABLE and ONE_SHOT_COMMANDS and contends for the command column with $82. Predict on `vib`/`depth`, NOT `bend`: siddump names semitone steps as notes.
